{{Quote|Soil samples in the claws and minerals in the blood confirm that all of these mutations originated in the same place and traveled to the locations where they are found.|[[Izaryx]]|<ref name="SWG:TWT" />}}
The '''Cave of Mutations''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Kyrisa]] performed [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] experiments on [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] in the cave, creating creatures considered as abominations by other [[Witches of Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:TWT" />
[[File:Cave_of_Mutations_rancors.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mutant rancors in the cave]]

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Cave of Mutations was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TWT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Cave of Mutations was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Witches of Dathomir Theme Park|Witches of Dathomir Theme Park]]," introduced upon the release of the [[W:c:swg:Game Update 19|Game Update 19]] on [[December 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="GU19">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1160720|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 19}}</ref>
